title: Physical prefix-release streaming pipeline
hypothesis: When semantic prefixes are independently processable, chunk-level release can overlap transfer and downstream CPU work, changing deadline feasibility and logical buffering relative to a full-object barrier while preserving semantic output.
falsifiers: semantic signature differs between full-barrier and streaming lanes
prefix streaming misses the frozen deadline
streaming fails to complete all CPU quanta by the deadline
streaming does not materially improve completion time
streaming requires the same full-object logical buffer before downstream work
